premiumPreview.summary: Design local-first preference synchronization with per-key revisions, durable offline commands, and deterministic cross-device convergence.
learningOutcomes: Separate confirmed preference values from optimistic overlays and sync state.
Persist idempotent commands that survive reloads and offline sessions.
Use per-key revisions and an opaque sync cursor without mixing version scopes.
Resolve conflicts by product policy instead of unreliable client timestamps.
Apply remote changes without stealing focus or obscuring overwritten intent.
premiumPreview.unlockDescription: Premium unlocks the per-key revision model, offline conflict walkthrough, tab coordination, recovery matrix, and accessibility decisions.
